review_text: Really good service by Kabir. Super happy with my experience at Beanlore.
It was a great experience in this cafe. Loved the service by Samay. He was very professional on his way of doing things.

Found this place recently and it’s already a favorite. Samay is the standout here; he handled my order with total precision and was incredibly professional throughout. You can tell he really knows what he’s doing, and his positive energy makes the whole atmosphere that much better. Highly recommended.

Taste of Alfredo penne pasta chicken was amazing even I liked liquid tiramisu Frappe which I had for the first time. It was something different which very few cafe serves so must try tq alok for serving me

The atmosphere here is spot on, but it’s the service that keeps me coming back. Samay is always on top of his game, consistently providing professional and friendly service every time I stop by. It’s refreshing to visit a place where you know you’re going to be looked after so well. Keep it up
Love the service at Beanlore HSR. Samay is always so welcoming and makes the best suggestions. Best spot in the neighborhood.
